summary: Completed frontend-only validation on public preview URL for redesigned dark banners, TwoSides, and MegaDiagram. Core interactions, responsive behavior, and motion-path integrity passed with one minor design-language mismatch.

issues: App.css uses 'Space Grotesk' for .hero-headline, while design_guidelines.json specifies Cabinet Grotesk for headings; this weakens strict design-language compliance.

action_items: Align heading font implementation with design guideline (Cabinet Grotesk) if strict guideline conformance is required.
Optional: keep orbit dots rendered (even when out of viewport) if static DOM presence for all test IDs is required by future automation strategy.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking regressions found in requested scope. Lemniscate/Atomic dots are constrained using native animateMotion + mpath and stayed on-path within small sampled tolerance.
Icosahedron rendered with coherent 12-vertex/30-edge structure and balanced left/right projection.
TwoSides and MegaDiagram interactions are keyboard/mouse usable and update detail state correctly across breakpoints.
test_credentials: Missing file: /app/memory/test_credentials.md (not needed for this frontend-only, non-auth test run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the same public URL. Prior run validated desktop/tablet/mobile responsiveness, no console/app errors, no horizontal overflow, and tested path-locked motion via sampled dot-to-path distance checks.
rca of the issue: Minor design mismatch RCA: typography token drift. Root cause appears to be hardcoded heading font-family in App.css (.hero-headline uses Space Grotesk) while design_guidelines.json enforces Cabinet Grotesk. Mitigation: align heading font token in CSS/theme source and re-verify visual hierarchy consistency.
